data.desc: Palisade Bio is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing oral therapies for immune-mediated and fibrotic diseases. Its lead program, PALI-2108, is in Phase 2 development in inflammatory bowel disease. The Company is actively enrolling patients in its Phase 2b ASCENTRA-UC study, while advancing its Phase 2a ASCENTRA-CD study toward commencement.
